locations.name: Rushlight Landing
locations.description: Reed ferries meet at a brick pumping station.

locations.name: Leeward Inn
locations.description: The bell above the slate switchbacks rings before each gust.

locations.name: Lamplighter Refuge
locations.description: Rope bridges hang between the roots of an ancient lantern tree.

sites.name: Floodgate Archive
sites.lesson: Turn the pump wheel. The striped intake drains, joining the ledger room to the upper catwalk.

sites.name: Signal Spire
sites.lesson: Raise the windbreak. Cross the pale wind stripes between gusts, then watch the west perch or clear the east platform.

sites.name: Lantern Court
sites.lesson: Unlatch the high bridge and follow the courier between the lanterns. A search party protects the low signet press.

sites.name: Cinder Rail Depot
sites.lesson: Switch the siding, then board the freight platform at the striped track. The eastern booth holds a duplicate manifest.

sites.name: Mirror Cistern
sites.lesson: Rotate the heliostat until the beam opens the seal. Cross the shaft between sweeps, or use the guarded manual override.

sites.name: Blackglass Command Vault
sites.lesson: Cut the maintenance relay to reach document storage unseen. The east gatehouse leads to the same courtyard with its captured order.

ops.title: The Missing Satchel
ops.brief: My sister signed for sacks that never reached Willow. Watch the handoff before you follow her signature.
ops.lead: Watch the orchard stile or intercept the red satchel.
ops.clue: A violet wax seal covers an older Willow mark.
ops.result: Saffron recognizes the seal of the north mill. The courier was diverted, not lost.

ops.title: Two Names for One Road
ops.brief: Someone pays my mill twice for one load. My boy drove the second cart.
ops.lead: Read the bridge tally or recover the second toll slip.
ops.clue: Both carts carry the same serial number.
ops.result: The mill copy records departures an hour early. Look for the false wagon at Fern Hollow.

ops.title: A Minute of Silence
ops.brief: Ironwhisker kept the mill witnesses apart. With the orchard fort free, their last report reached me.
ops.lead: Listen through the relay pause or seize the signal book.
ops.clue: The relay goes quiet before every eastbound convoy.
ops.result: That silent minute is a departure signal. Freight is travelling under flood-relief orders.

ops.title: White Chalk on the Axle
ops.brief: After Bramble fell, the wheelwright brought me a rubbing from my missing crew’s axle.
ops.lead: Trace wheel marks at the pass or take the quartermaster’s stencil.
ops.clue: A three-bar axle mark identifies empty relief wagons.
ops.result: Empty wagons visit Hushfen and leave riding low. The pumping archive keeps the real weights.

ops.title: The Weight of Water
ops.brief: Flintfang seized my pump records. The archive key was in his battery. The men listed as cargo are still alive.
ops.lead: Drain the ledger intake or recover its duplicate from the lift guard.
ops.clue: The intake ledger lists people by the weight of their kit.
ops.result: The dry culvert opens. The prisoners’ route is being transmitted under a weather call sign.

ops.title: Someone Answers Snow
ops.brief: Whiteclaw’s operator survived. She begs us to answer the next transmission in her brother’s voice.
ops.lead: Monitor the snowline band or recover the operator’s acetate.
ops.clue: Three low tones request a bearing from the Signal Spire.
ops.result: Glasswind hears the false weather calls. Read the echoes from opposite sides of its spire.

ops.title: Signals in the Lee
ops.brief: My roof bell rings in still weather. I kept the clapper for the climber who never came down.
ops.lead: Record the sheltered perch or seize the eastern strip chart.
ops.clue: A descending pair of flashes identifies the westbound relay.
ops.result: The cable lift runs again. The next signal is handed to a lantern courier under the canopy.

ops.title: The Empty Signet
ops.brief: Miretooth had my seal, but his letters kept arriving after he fell. Someone took an impression.
ops.lead: Shadow the signet courier or recover wax at the low press.
ops.clue: The forged signet has a chip shaped like a moth.
ops.result: The inside bridge opens to resistance traffic. Moth-stamped bills travel to the Cinder yard.

ops.title: Last Car on the Siding
ops.brief: With Geargnash gone I can switch one train. My missing apprentices signed out that carriage.
ops.lead: Board the slow freight cart or raid the signal booth.
ops.clue: The last car carries mirror glass instead of munitions.
ops.result: The service tunnel bypasses the yard. The mirror shipment was rerouted toward Sunscar.

ops.title: A Map Made of Light
ops.brief: Sirocco used to hide dry wells on our maps. This time someone has hidden a city.
ops.lead: Project the seal pattern or force the hand-cranked override.
ops.clue: The projected seal exposes the missing Berlin map grid.
ops.result: A shaft ladder returns to daylight. The false grid and the relay schedule intersect at Dawnbridge.

ops.title: The Names Under the Map
ops.brief: Blackbanner’s fall lets our witness travel. Give me one last confirmation before I send anyone through that gate.
ops.lead: Compare the witness’s overlay or intercept the sealed gate order.
ops.clue: The command relay has a document lift and an eastern gatehouse.
ops.result: Both entrances to Blackglass are marked. The document lift carries a relay shutdown code.

ops.title: Behind the Black Glass
ops.brief: The dispatches were lists of witnesses. Whisker means to erase them at the last transmission.
ops.lead: Decode the maintenance relay or take the courtyard order by force.
ops.clue: The next transmission will come from Whisker’s own arena.
ops.result: The courtyard checkpoint is open. Take both heroes through the hatch and confront Adolph Whisker.

challenges.title: Lantern census
challenges.brief: Record both the high courier and low press without sounding the alarm. East patrol doubled.

challenges.title: Unbroken seal
challenges.brief: Recover the freight seal at the booth, then carry it aboard the cart without taking damage. Guards hold the siding.

challenges.title: Against the current
challenges.brief: Claim both ledger copies and extract through the dry culvert. Two guards cover the lower channel.
